environment.description: Django application deployed on EC2 with PostgreSQL RDS. The Django DATABASES setting uses a database role 'app_user' which has been granted ALL PRIVILEGES on the public schema including SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on all tables. The application runs behind an nginx reverse proxy with no request filtering. DEBUG=False in production. No authentication middleware is applied to this endpoint (internal service assumption).

config.database_grants: GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_user
